text:
Marta K: Quick sync — planning to flip the sensitive_logging_v2 audit_mode flag for EU only next Tue 08:00 UTC. Goal: enable audit-mode (no persistent logs) for 2% EU canary, verify scrubbing and retention before wider rollout.
Devin R: +1 on canary. Can we gate by customer.kms_type so we prefer HSM path when configured? Also we need a rollback plan if KV cache spikes.
Marta K: Yes — gating logic will be: if customer.kms_type == "HSM" -> route to hsm_encryption_path, else use cloud_kms. I'll add explicit fallback and a kill-switch for immediate disable.
Song Li: Heads-up — scrubber pipeline currently lags ~300ms under peak. For canary keep payload size small and disable verbose debug logs.
Samir A: I'll add a scrub-before-index hook. Proposed sequence: 1) enable audit_mode (no persistent logs) 2) route snapshots to ephemeral S3 prefix 3) run scrubber job -> verify PII metrics.
Leah P: What telemetry do we want to watch during canary? Suggest: 1) scrub_fail_rate, 2) log_ingest_latency, 3) retention_queue_depth, 4) KMS_errors.
Marta K: Good list. I'll add dashboards and alert thresholds: scrub_fail_rate > 0.5% => auto-disable; log_ingest_latency > 1s (p50) => rollback.
Devin R: Also add an audit log sample check (daily) with masked fields automated check. If sampling detects unmasked PII -> immediate disable and postmortem.
Marta K: Will add automated sample and slack notify to #incidents and #eng-sre. Can we get an ops bot trigger for the kill-switch? @OpsBot can you confirm a manual toggle endpoint exists?
OpsBot: deploybot: Manual feature toggle endpoint present: POST /api/ops/flags/toggle {name, env, state}. Canary runbook ID: runbook/547.
Samir A: PR opened with scrub-before-index change: https://git.internal/r/redwood/scrubber/pull/312 — requesting review from @Song Li and @Leah P. Small config change to add ephemeral prefix and retention TTL.
Song Li: reviewing now, will check perf impact and add a benchmark.
Leah P: LGTM for config, will validate retention TTL mapping for EU regs.
Marta K: Final checklist before canary: 1) ops runbook linked, 2) kill-switch verified, 3) dashboards + alerts created, 4) PR merged, 5) canary cohort defined (EU customers with < 10k monthly tokens). Anyone object to rollout Tue 08:00?
Devin R: no objections.
Song Li: nope.
Samir A: all good from infra side.
Marta K: Thanks — I'll schedule the flag flip and post the canary start in this thread. If you want to be paged for the canary start ping @Leah P and @Devin R.
OpsBot: deploybot: Canary scheduled: sensitive_logging_v2 -> EU 2% -> start 1798769600. Monitor runbook/547.
Marta K: Posting follow-up checklist in docs shortly: https://docs.internal/redwood/security/feature-flags/sensitive_logging_v2
